_README: Hydrocyclone catalogue. One entry per unit.
cut.d20Um / d50Um / d90Um are SEPARATION sizes: the particle size at which
20% / 50% / 90% of the mass of that size reports to the underflow. They are
NOT membrane pore sizes and must never be treated as one.
Every numeric field has a matching entry in `status`, which is one of:
guessed        - a starting estimate. Not measured, not from a datasheet.
field-adjusted - revised from field observations. See `revisions`.
measured       - from a rig test or datasheet. Cite it in `source`.
To adjust a parameter from field data, change the value, set its status,
and append to `revisions`. Never change a value without a revision entry.

hydrocyclones.name: 5 mm hydrocyclone
hydrocyclones.source: Diameter is the nominal designation. All performance values are guesses.
notes: A smaller body gives a finer cut than a larger one at comparable conditions. That ordering is the only thing these guesses are anchored to.
Highest-value measurement: size the feed and the overflow on the same run to get a real d50.

revisions.because: The physical unit is 5 mm, not 4 mm - a labelling correction, not a new measurement. Cut sizes and operating envelope are unchanged: they were already guessed and anchored only to the smaller-cuts-finer ordering against the 10 mm unit, which still holds.

hydrocyclones.name: 10 mm hydrocyclone
hydrocyclones.source: Diameter is the nominal designation. All performance values are guesses.
notes: Coarser cut than the 5 mm unit, and passes considerably more flow.
Highest-value measurement: size the feed and the overflow on the same run to get a real d50.
